comments: This test failed three more times this week, I'm muting it

This failed again [here](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/pxbf3fifxypri/console-log?task=:x-pack:plugin:autoscaling:internalClusterTest) in 8.5. Re-opening issue. If I see more occurrences, I will mute it.

Sadly, it failed again on [8.6](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/bd2svp4evr5lq/tests/:x-pack:plugin:autoscaling:internalClusterTest/org.elasticsearch.xpack.autoscaling.existence.FrozenExistenceDeciderIT/testZeroToOne). The increased timeout seems not to be enough. I'll keep an eye on it today, since it does not happen always - I will not mute it for now.
Unfortunately, this has been failing several times. Maybe the issue not the timeout? I'll mute it since it fails kind of often.

review_comments: Could you please explain why it needs this dependencies? CCR looks especially surprising for me
